constraints.constraint: Zero Core Modification: Must not modify rustybt core modules
Log Schema Compatibility: Integration must support same JSONL schema (Layer 1-5 events)
Deterministic Execution: Results must be reproducible
CLI Interface Preservation: execute_rustybt.py must maintain same CLI contract (--strategy, --data, --output, --params)
Validation Pattern: Use ValidatedStrategyMixin logging infrastructure
